English: Story Circle
A humble fire-lit ring where elders and travelers share tales, strengthening the unity of the clan.
Chroniclers Tent
A weathered tent where a clan scribe records deeds and births, preserving memory and boosting prestige.
Rune Reader Hut
A modest wooden hut where rune masters interpret omens, fostering wisdom and unity among the clansfolk.
Scribes Pavilion
A large, canvas-roofed gathering where scribes copy sagas and genealogy, aiding in the spread of stories and learning.
Lorekeepers Bench
A solid timber bench for the appointed lorekeeper, granting structure to the oral tradition and enhancing clan prestige.
Tale Hall
A sturdy wooden hall where entire clans gather for recitations, feasts, and council, greatly boosting unity and memory.
Archivists Chamber
A fortified archive built from logs and stone, where clan records and relics are safeguarded for posterity.
Saga Room
A grand chamber decorated with carved panels, where the greatest stories are inscribed and retold for generations.
Chroniclers Hall
A stately timber longhouse, home to multiple chroniclers and their apprentices, who document every aspect of clan life.
Great Lore House
A monumental seat of wisdom, where sages, chroniclers, and loremasters gather to preserve, teach, and guide all clans under one banner.
